unit: KSh. Main fields converted from KSh millions (2 d.p.) in CoB Tables 2.1 and 2.5 by multiplying by 1,000,000, so they are rounded to the nearest KSh 10,000. 'ch3Exact' gives unconverted whole-KSh figures from each county's section-3 tables.

national.scope: All 47 county governments, aggregate totals (the report gives totals, not per-county averages)
national.notes: Totals from Table 2.5 (p.9) and Table 2.1 (p.3). Text (pp.2, 7, 8) agrees in billions: budget Kshs.601.69bn, expenditure Kshs.470.74bn (78%), development budget Kshs.218.99bn, development expenditure Kshs.123.76bn (57%), recurrent Kshs.346.98bn (91%), OSR Kshs.67.30bn = 77% of Kshs.87.67bn target. Table 2.1 'Total' row prints performance as 4,145 (a column sum, not a rate), so osrPerformancePct is taken from the text on p.2 (77%). Table 2.4 (pp.7-8) gives the same recurrent/development/total expenditure. population2019 is the Kenya total from KNBS Table 2.2.
